definitionZh: 此组件使用 [IntersectionObserver API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IntersectionObserver) 来跟踪其直接子元素何时进入或离开指定的根元素。每当元素跨越可见性阈值时，就会触发“wa-intersect”事件。
sourceDefinition: This component uses the [IntersectionObserver API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/IntersectionObserver) to track when its direct children enter or leave a designated root element. The `wa-intersect` event fires whenever elements cross the visibility threshold.
